name: Silo's own extensions
what: The extensions that ship with Silo come with the same manifest as an extension you add, and Silo holds them to it as it holds yours. Anyone can read their files.

suggest.why: It builds nothing of its own: what it says binds every extension Silo ships through decisions already in the plan, and each extension Silo would ship is a feature of its own, all in the stage later.
